text: レッドは　＊の　＊を　でて　さきを　いそいだ！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one action to the next, like 'and then'. でて　さきを　いそいだ = 'left and hurried onward'.

patterns.name: 〜を (place left or passed through)
patterns.explanation: With verbs of moving, を shows the place you leave or go through. ＊を　でて = 'leaving ＊'.
